content: Auth choice for single-user personal app on Supabase: Use Supabase Auth, not NextAuth. Reason: Already on Supabase, so Supabase Auth has zero additional dependencies, cookie-based sessions via @supabase/ssr integrate with App Router middleware naturally, and it eliminates the need for a separate database adapter. NextAuth v5 adds complexity with no benefit here. For a single-user app, use email+password login only — no OAuth needed. Protect routes via middleware.ts checking supabase.auth.getUser().
